snippet.title: FNF: REMNANTS - RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD: https://gamebanana.com/mods/653229

What is Funkin' Remnants? It started out as a gimmick account on Twitter that's dedicated to archiving old content for Friday Night Funkin'!

Now we've developed a fully fledged remix mod for the game which features many unused elements that have been covered on Funkin' Remnants Socials before.

It also has a pretty nice wireframe style that tries to recapture the simpler vibes of other popular remix mods from back in the day. Neat ain't it?

Sing against your wireframe self in a space between dimensions and then play as them through Character Select to experience about 35 bangin' remixed tracks! There's lots to see...

Funkin' Remnants Social Links:
Twitter - https://twitter.com/FunkinRemnants
Discord - https://discord.gg/cXkpnUfreZ

Trailer by MarkedAman:
https://x.com/markedaman
Thumbnail Artwork by DigitLuck:
https://x.com/digit_luck

Developed by The Funkin' Remnants Crew (2026)
